lyrics.original: 深夜情绪反复过载
lyrics.romanization: shēnyè qíngxù fǎnfù guòzài
lyrics.english: Late-night emotions keep overflowing again and again

lyrics.original: 屏幕闪烁黑白色块
lyrics.romanization: píngmù shǎnshuò hēibáisèk uài
lyrics.english: The screen flickers with black-and-white patches

lyrics.original: 将我藏进喧嚣人海
lyrics.romanization: jiāng wǒ cáng jìn xuānxiāo rénhǎi
lyrics.english: I hide myself among the noisy crowd

lyrics.original: 吵闹掩饰了独白
lyrics.romanization: chǎonào yǎnshì le dúbái
lyrics.english: The noise disguises my inner monologue

lyrics.original: 脚步还在原地重复徘徊
lyrics.romanization: jiǎobù hái zài yuándì chóngfù páihuái
lyrics.english: My footsteps keep wandering in circles, repeating the same path

lyrics.original: 黑色的迷雾中 我独自等待
lyrics.romanization: hēisè de míwù zhōng wǒ dúzì děngdài
lyrics.english: Alone, I wait in the black fog

lyrics.original: 该对谁坦白
lyrics.romanization: gāi duì shéi tǎnbái
lyrics.english: Who should I confess this to?

lyrics.original: 那看不见的未来 no no no no
lyrics.romanization: nà kàn bù jiàn de wèilái no no no no
lyrics.english: That invisible future no no no no

lyrics.original: 我站在十字路口, 手足无措 no no
lyrics.romanization: wǒ zhàn zài shízì lùkǒu, shǒuzú wúcuò no no
lyrics.english: I stand at the crossroads, At a loss, not knowing what to do no no

lyrics.original: 我所有挣扎与忧愁, 星光下化为乌有
lyrics.romanization: wǒ suǒyǒu zhēngzhá yǔ yōuchóu, xīngguāng xià huà wéi wūyǒu
lyrics.english: All my struggles and worries, Disappear beneath the starlight

lyrics.original: 当我在不安中不断漂流
lyrics.romanization: dāng wǒ zài bù'ān zhōng bùduàn piāoliú
lyrics.english: When I keep drifting in my anxiety

lyrics.original: 我会望向你明亮的眼眸
lyrics.romanization: wǒ huì wàngxiàng nǐ míngliàng de yǎnmóu
lyrics.english: I'll look into your bright eyes

lyrics.original: 夜空的星斗
lyrics.romanization: yèkōng de xīngdǒu
lyrics.english: The stars in the night sky

lyrics.original: 一切都指引我走向你 in your halo
lyrics.romanization: yíqiè dōu zhǐyǐn wǒ zǒuxiàng nǐ in your halo
lyrics.english: Everything guides me toward you, in your halo

lyrics.original: Halo, Halo, ooh, 照亮我一直往前走
lyrics.romanization: halo, halo, ooh, zhàoliàng wǒ yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu
lyrics.english: Halo, halo, ooh, You light the way and keep me moving forward

lyrics.original: Halo, Halo, ooh, 有你我终于敢自由
lyrics.romanization: halo, halo, ooh, yǒu nǐ wǒ zhōngyú gǎn zìyóu
lyrics.english: Halo, halo, ooh, With you, I finally dare to be free

lyrics.original: 像一阵风, 吹散了所有阴霾 baby
lyrics.romanization: xiàng yí zhèn fēng, chuī sàn le suǒyǒu yīnmái baby
lyrics.english: Like a gust of wind, Blowing away all the gloom, baby

lyrics.original: 像一束光, 黑白的城市也有了色彩
lyrics.romanization: xiàng yí shù guāng, hēibái de chéngshì yě yǒu le sècǎi
lyrics.english: Like a ray of light, Even the black-and-white city becomes colorful

lyrics.original: 迷茫都被温柔替代
lyrics.romanization: mímáng dōu bèi wēnróu tìdài
lyrics.english: All my confusion is replaced by tenderness

lyrics.original: 你懂我的每次开怀
lyrics.romanization: nǐ dǒng wǒ de měi cì kāihuái
lyrics.english: You understand every time I laugh

lyrics.original: 当黑夜重返
lyrics.romanization: dāng hēiyè chóngfǎn
lyrics.english: When the darkness returns

lyrics.original: 这次 这次我不想离开
lyrics.romanization: zhè cì zhè cì wǒ bù xiǎng líkāi
lyrics.english: This time, this time, I don't want to leave
